name: Guerrilla
summary: Guerrillas fight against oppressive leadership and governments including Chelish colonization in Sargava and the power structures in Cheliax proper, Nidal, and Razmiran
replacesText: Trapfinding; Evasion; Trap Sense; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge

features.name: Skilled Liar (Ex)
features.summary: Whenever a guerrilla uses Bluff to attempt to deceive someone, she gains a bonus on the opposed roll equal to 1/2 her rogue level (minimum +1). A guerrilla can still use Disable Device to disarm magic traps. This ability replaces trapfinding.

features.name: Cover of Night (Ex)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a guerrilla learns to use darkness to her advantage. She gains a +5 bonus on Disguise, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks while she is in areas of dim light or darkness, and can create mundane disguises in dim light or darkness with a full-round action (instead of the normal 1d3 Ã— 10 minutes). Additionally, while in dim light or darkness, if a guerrilla would have concealment, she instead has total concealment. This ability replaces evasion.

features.name: Secret Messenger (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a guerrilla gains a +1 bonus on Bluff checks to convey secret messages and on Sense Motive checks to discern secret messages. These bonuses increase by 1 every 3 rogue levels thereafter (to a maximum of +6 at 18th level). This ability replaces trap sense.

features.name: Guerrilla Sniping (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, when a guerrilla is in an area of dim light or darkness, she takes only a –10 penalty on her Stealth check to maintain her obscured location while sniping. This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
features.summary: At 8th level, a guerrilla gains uncanny dodge. This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.

features.name: Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following rogue talents complement the guerrilla archetype camouflage APG , fast stealth, powerful sneak APG , rogue crawl, stand up, and surprise attack.

features.name: Advanced Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following advanced rogue talents complement the guerrilla archetype deadly sneak APG , master of disguise APG , stealthy sniper APG , and opportunist.

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.
